title: Expired first patent and a new second patent (raised by Flint Dibble)

tellings.quote: Yes, my initial patent at the moment is expired.

plain: The researcher Filippo Biondi, whose work is behind claims that a huge hidden energy grid lies beneath the pyramids of Egypt, admits that his first US patent has expired and says he now has a second one. He answers this himself, first-hand, after Flint Dibble raised the point in a video criticising him: "Yes, my initial patent at the moment is expired." The question matters because the patents are part of how Biondi's method is judged.
